description_en: Queries API security user risk types and statistics
description_zh: 查询API安全用户风险类型和统计
name: DescribeUserAbnormalType

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster. 
This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation to obtain the hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query, in UNIX timestamp format (UTC). Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query, in UNIX timestamp format (UTC). Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of statuses for risk statistics.

By default, risk data in the toBeConfirmed, toBeFixed, toBeVerified, and notFixed states is collected
parameters.help_zh:
风险统计的状态列表。

默认统计 toBeConfirmed、toBeFixed、toBeVerified、notFixed状态的风险数据
parameters.name: user_status_list

Abnormal.description_en: The list of risk types and statistics

items.description_en: The risk type and statistics information

AbnormalParentType.description_en: The parent type of the risk

AbnormalType.description_en:
The risk type.

You can call the [DescribeApisecRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html） operation to obtain the supported risk types
AbnormalType.description_zh:
风险类型。

您可以调用[DescribeApisecRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html）获取支持的风险类型
